sources.title: Fed Governor Cook Won’t Attend White House Hearing Without Changes
Lisa Cook lawyer signals Fed gov won't attend Trump committee's hearing

en.title: Cook lawyer states Fed governor will not attend White House hearing
en.dek: Lisa Cook's attorney stated in a letter on November 16 that the hearing process lacks necessary changes.
facts: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook has not been charged with mortgage fraud.
A lawyer for Ms. Cook, Abbe David Lowell, sent a letter to the White House on November 16.
Lowell stated Governor Cook has no legal obligation to participate in an unfair hearing.
The White House committee investigating mortgage fraud was established last month by President Donald Trump.
body: Abbe David Lowell, who represents Ms. Cook, stated in a letter to the White House on November 16 that Governor Cook will not attend the hearing regarding mortgage fraud allegations.
Lowell wrote that Governor Cook has a duty to the Federal Reserve to decline any proceeding that would undermine the institution’s unique status and independence.
The committee, which President Donald Trump established last month, is investigating allegations of mortgage fraud against Cook.
Lowell accused the White House of seeking to manufacture 'cause' for a predetermined removal outcome.
en.context: President Trump has previously attempted to remove Cook from the central bank's board, and the hearing addresses allegations of mortgage fraud.

de.title: Fed-Gouverneur Lisa Cook wird White House-Hörung fernbleiben
de.dek: Anwalt von Lisa Cook: Anhörungsverfahren fehlt notwendige Änderungen
facts: Lisa Cook wurde nicht wegen Hypothekenbetrugs angeklagt
Lowell sandte am 16. November Brief an das Weiße Haus
Lowell: Cook habe keine rechtliche Pflicht, an ungerechtem Verfahren teilzunehmen
Untersuchungsausschuss für Hypothekenbetrug wurde von Präsident Trump vor einem Monat eingerichtet
body: Abbe David Lowell, der Frau Cook vertritt, erklärte in einem Schreiben an das Weiße Haus vom 16. November, dass Gouverneur Cook an der Anhörung zu Vorwürfen des Hypothekenbetrugs nicht teilnehmen wird.

Lowell schrieb, dass Gouverneur Cook eine Pflicht gegenüber der Federal Reserve habe, jegliches Verfahren abzulehnen, das den einzigartigen Status und die Unabhängigkeit der Institution untergraben würde.
Der von Präsident Donald Trump letzten Monat eingesetzte Ausschuss untersucht Vorwürfe des Hypothekenbetrugs gegen Cook.
Lowell warf dem Weißen Haus vor, versuche, einen „Grund“ für ein vorherbestimmtes Entlassungsergebnis zu erfinden.
de.context: Trump versuchte zuvor, Cook aus dem Zentralbankrat zu entfernen; Anhörung befasst sich mit Hypothekenbetrugsvorwürfen

zh.title: 律师称联邦理事将不出席白宫听证会
zh.dek: 科克的律师在11月16日的信中称，听证程序缺乏必要的更改
facts: 联邦理事科克未被指控抵押贷款欺诈
科克的律师洛威尔于11月16日向白宫发送信件
洛威尔称科克理事无法律义务参加不公平的听证
调查抵押贷款欺诈的白宫委员会由特朗普总统上月成立
body: 代理人Abbe David Lowell在11月16日致白宫的信中表示，代表Cook女士的律师称，Cook州长将不会出席有关抵押贷款欺诈指控的听证会。
Lowell写道，Cook州长有责任拒绝任何可能损害该机构独特地位和独立性的联邦储备委员会的程序。
该委员会由唐纳德·特朗普总统上个月成立，正在调查针对Cook的抵押贷款欺诈指控。
Lowell指责白宫试图制造“理由”，以达成预先决定的罢免结果。
zh.context: 特朗普总统此前曾试图将科克从中央银行理事会撤职，该听证会涉及抵押贷款欺诈指控

ko.title: 쿠키 변호사, 연방준비제도 이사가 백악관 청문회 참석 안 한다고 밝혀
ko.dek: 리사 쿠키 변호사가 16일 서한을 통해 청문 절차가 필요한 변경을 갖추지 못했다고 주장함
facts: 연방준비제도 이사 리사 쿠키가 모기지 사기 혐의로 기소되지 않음
쿠키 변호사 애비 데이비드 로웰이 16일 백악관에 서한 발송
로웰 "쿠키 이사는 부당한 청문에 참여할 법적 의무가 없다"
지난달 트럼프 대통령이 설립한 모기지 사기 조사 위원회
body: 쿠크 씨를 대리하는 애비 데이비드 로웰은 11월 16일 백악관에 보낸 서한에서 쿠크 주지사가 모기지 사기 혐의 관련 청문회에 참석하지 않을 것이라고 밝혔다.
로웰은 쿠크 주지사가 해당 기관의 고유한 지위와 독립성을 훼손할 수 있는 모든 절차에 대해 연방준비제도에 의무적으로 거부할 의무가 있다고 썼다.
도널드 트럼프 대통령이 지난달 구성한 이 위원회는 쿠크에 대한 모기지 사기 혐의를 조사하고 있다.
로웰은 백악관이 미리 정해진 해임 결과를 위한 '명분'을 조작하려 한다고 비난했다.
ko.context: 트럼프 대통령이 이전에 쿠키를 중앙은행 이사회에서 해임하려 했음 || 청문회는 모기지 사기 혐의에 대한 것임

problemsFixed: The headline uses a non-factual framing ('refuses') without attribution; it should state what the lawyer said.
The dek is too long and uses evaluative language ('says she will not attend').
The facts list contains unattributed claims and uses loaded language ('façade').
The body contains unattributed claims and uses loaded language ('predetermined to find the governor guilty').
The final sentence of the body attributes reporting to the wrong outlet (Tony Romm is listed as covering for The Times, not CNBC, and Colby Smith is listed for The Times, not CNBC).
The context uses evaluative framing ('Her lawyer says the process is unfair and designed to force her out').
The structure violates rhythm rules (e.g., short declarative sentences in a row) and paragraph opening rules (starting with the same noun as the previous paragraph).
